applicabilityBasis.summary: RealFi markets USDrf as a USD stablecoin for everyday digital transactions and trading, designed to track $1. Its July 23, 2026 Terms and Institutional Minting Agreement give holders who open an account with RealFi Reserve Ltd. the right to redeem for an equivalent amount of U.S. dollars, at one dollar per USDrf less fees and payable to a connected bank account, and state that USDrf pays no interest or return. Account-gated access and the off-chain credit reserve do not remove the fixed-value national-currency redemption obligation that GENIUS section 2(22) uses to define a payment stablecoin. The docs' risk disclaimer that USDrf provides exposure to a portfolio of real-world financial instruments describes reserve risk, not a variable redemption value.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-11-15. The USDrf Terms and Institutional Minting Agreement name RealFi Reserve Ltd., a British Virgin Islands company, as issuer and redemption counterparty. RealFi Yield Ltd. issues sUSDrf and the Cayman Islands RealFi Foundation governs the protocol; neither is the USDrf issuer. RealFi states that USDrf is not classified as a regulated financial instrument under current BVI virtual asset guidelines. That is an issuer statement, not a regulator determination, and no licence is recorded. U.S. persons and U.S.-organized entities cannot hold USDrf or become Mint Users, and the app geo-blocks restricted jurisdictions. These are issuer eligibility restrictions, not a GENIUS exclusion, foreign exception or DASP restriction; DASP posture reflects the pre-effective regime only. The Institutional Minting Agreement publishes operative redemption terms, so redemptionPolicyPresent is true. RealFi names HT Digital as reserve attestation provider, but on 2026-11-15 its attestation page still said documentation would be available shortly and no report was found, so monthlyAttestationPresent is false. The transparency portal at realfi.co/transparency redirected to a geo-restriction page from the review location and was not inspected, and the docs publish allocation strategy only, so reserveDisclosurePresent is not asserted. The negative authorization and enforcement findings are bounded by the sources checked and do not exclude nonpublic filings.
